subject: Request: Temporary P1/P2 Response Window Adjustment — ClearBank Systems
messages:
From: Jim Owens <jim.owens@clearbank.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearbank.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Temporary SLA window request for Dec 10-12 maintenance

Hi Ben —

Quick context: ClearBank has a coordinated platform upgrade scheduled for Dec 10-12 (overnight batches, db schema migration). Our ops team expects an uptick in incident noise during the migration and immediate post-migration verification window.

We rely on Redwood's standard support response SLAs for production incidents (P1 — 30m initial response, P2 — 2h). For those three nights we want to request a temporary escalation policy that: 
- relaxes the P1 initial response to 60 minutes (for infra noise related to the upgrade)
- relaxes P2 to 4 hours for non-customer-impacting functional anomalies
- adds a direct on-call channel to our lead SRE (single point contact) to avoid duplicate paging

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a short-term exception and whether we need a contract amendment or written approval? I attached the maintenance schedule.

Thanks,
Jim Owens
Director, Platform Ops
ClearBank Systems

Attachments: clearbank_maintenance_window.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Jim Owens <jim.owens@clearbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA window request for Dec 10-12 maintenance

Jim —

Thanks for the heads-up and the schedule. We can support a temporary change but need to confirm on-call coverage and the escalation path to ensure SLAs remain enforceable. Quick summary of what I propose to move this forward: 

1) Temporary response windows: P1 initial response -> 60 minutes; P2 initial response -> 4 hours. These apply only to incidents flagged as "migration noise" by ClearBank during the three-night window.
2) Single-point contact: Add an SRE lead contact (Clara Morales) to the incident routing so we avoid duplicate pages.
3) On-call coverage: I'll loop in Karthik to confirm we can expand overnight on-call for those dates with the agreed rotation.
4) Contract/approval: I can draft a 3-day exception memo signed by our CS leader (Laura) — that should be sufficient for operational records; procurement can accept or request a formal amendment.

If that sounds right I'll start the approval note and Karthik can confirm coverage by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_oncall-rota.xlsx (xls, 45KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jim Owens <jim.owens@clearbank.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA window request for Dec 10-12 maintenance

Ben / Laura —

I reviewed the request and the schedule. We can provide expanded on-call coverage for Dec 10-12 overnight windows with the following constraints: 
- Coverage will be on a volunteer rotation of two engineers per night, 10pm–6am ET; one engineer will be primary, the other backup.
- For incidents clearly attributable to the ClearBank migration (application-level noise vs platform regressions) we accept the relaxed P1/P2 initial-response windows.
- If the issue escalates to a platform outage (multi-tenant impact), standard P1 SLA and cross-tenant escalation policies apply and we will treat as a platform incident.

Action items: 
- Ben: confirm Clara Morales as the ClearBank SRE single point of contact for routing.
- Laura: please sign the temporary exception memo so procurement can close the loop.

Karthik
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Jim Owens <jim.owens@clearbank.com>, procurement@clearbank.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Approval: Temporary P1/P2 response window for ClearBank (Dec 10-12)

Ben / Karthik —

Approved. I have signed the temporary exception memo and attached the signed PDF to our internal SUP ticket. Summary of approval terms (for the record): 
- Effective window: 2026-12-10 22:00 ET through 2026-12-13 06:00 ET (three nights).
- Temporary SLAs: P1 initial response target 60 minutes; P2 initial response target 4 hours. Applies only to incidents explicitly labeled by ClearBank as migration-related.
- On-call coverage: Two-person volunteer rotation each night (10pm–6am ET). Karthik to provide final rota by Dec 7.
- Platform-impact clause: Any cross-customer or platform outage will immediately revert to standard SLAs and platform incident playbooks.

Ben: please circulate the signed memo (I put it in SUP-4218) and confirm the single-point contact for routing. Jim / Procurement: please confirm Clara Morales' contact details so we can update routing rules.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: clearbank_maintenance_window.pdf, proposed_oncall-rota.xlsx
